run_api_server: run the HuggingFace datasets-server API server with uvicorn on configured host and port
create_app: create a Starlette application with endpoints, middleware, and MongoDB resources from environment config
create_app_with_config: create a Starlette app with explicit AppConfig and EndpointConfig for the datasets API
test_healthcheck: test the /healthcheck endpoint of the HuggingFace datasets-server API
summarize_metrics: summarize the /metrics endpoint that exposes Prometheus metrics for the API server
